name: Kirishita Konoha
source:
The protagonist of the KYOHSO games.

A recent graduate who had newly entered the music company "DYNAMIC CHORD". Konoha is cheerful and positive. She is currently the manager of KYOHSO.

[Translation of [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/dynamic/kyoh/story.html]official website character profile[/URL].]
